Let me compile my findings: ## Codebase Exploration Report ### 1. **Framework & Routing Pattern** **Framework:** Next.js 16.4.0 with **App Router** (not Pages Router) - Uses file-based routing in `/app` directory - Routes: - `/` (home page via `app/page.tsx`) - `/dashboard` (via `app/dashboard/page.tsx`) - Root layout via `app/layout.tsx` **Key Routing Details:** - Path alias configured: `@/*` maps to project root - TypeScript strict mode enabled - React 19.3.0 with Server Components by default --- ### 2. **Page Structure & Layout Pattern** **Root Layout** (`/app/layout.tsx`): - Sets up global HTML structure with font variables - Wraps children with `ThemeProvider` (next-themes) - Renders header with navigation and theme toggle - Includes three Google Fonts loaded via `next/font/google`: - `Google_Sans_Flex` (body, button, heading) - `Host_Grotesk` (labels) - `Bricolage_Grotesque` (titles, hero) - Fonts exposed as CSS variables: `--font-google-sans-flex`, `--font-host-grotesk`, `--font-bricolage-grotesque` **Page Pattern:** - Pages export default async/sync components - Use semantic HTML (`
`, `
`, `
`) - Flexible layout using flex and grid utilities **Example: Home Page** (`/app/page.tsx`): ```tsx - Hero section with HeroText, HeroBodyText, and buttons - Pricing section with grid layout (responsive: 1 col → 3 cols at md breakpoint) - Uses design system text components and Button component - Calls async data function: getPlans() ``` **Example: Dashboard** (`/app/dashboard/page.tsx`): ```tsx - Title with description - Dropdown menu for filtering - Simple content area - Uses design system components: TitleText, BodyText, DropdownMenu ``` --- ### 3. **CSS/Styling System** **Primary Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4 with Turbopack integration **Setup Files:** - `/app/globals.css` - Global styles and Tailwind import - No separate `tailwind.config.ts` (uses design system preset) **CSS Imports in `globals.css`:** ```css @import "tailwindcss"; @import "@dooph-software/design-system/styles.css"; @import "@dooph-software/design-system/theme.css"; ``` **Font Token Mapping** (in `globals.css`): ```css :root { --ui-font-body: var(--font-google-sans-flex), system-ui, sans-serif; --ui-font-button: var(--font-google-sans-flex), system-ui, sans-serif; --ui-font-heading: var(--font-google-sans-flex), system-ui, sans-serif; --ui-font-label: var(--font-host-grotesk), system-ui, sans-serif; --ui-font-title: var(--font-bricolage-grotesque), ...; --ui-font-hero: var(--font-bricolage-grotesque), ...; } ``` **Tailwind Spacing Tokens Used:** `gap-md`, `px-xl`, `py-xxxl`, `gap-lg`, `rounded-soft`, `border-border-primary`, `bg-surface-primary`, `shadow-standard`, `text-text-secondary`, `text-text-tertiary`, etc. **Styling Approach:** Utility-first with design system component composition --- ### 4. **Shared Layout Components & Wrappers** **Root Layout** (`/app/layout.tsx`): - Wraps all pages - Header with navigation - ThemeProvider for dark/light mode **Theme Toggle** (`/components/theme-toggle.tsx`): - Client component (`"use client"`) - Uses `next-themes` hook `useTheme()` - Mounted check to prevent hydration mismatch - Exports ButtonVariant.ghost and ButtonSize.sm **Navigation Structure:** - Header includes links to `/` and `/dashboard` - ThemeToggle component in header --- ### 5. **Design System Package** **Package:** `@dooph-software/design-system` v5.3.0 - Installed from vendored tarball: `vendor/dooph-software-design-system-5.3.0.tgz` - Built on Radix UI primitives - Uses Tailwind CSS v4 - Provides styled components and utilities **Exported Components Used:** - Text components: `BodyText`, `TitleText`, `HeadingText`, `SubheadingText`, `LabelText`, `HeroText`, `HeroBodyText` - Interactive: `Button`, `DropdownMenu`, `DropdownMenuContent`, `DropdownMenuItem`, `DropdownMenuSection`, `DropdownMenuTrigger`, `DropdownTrigger` - Button variants/sizes: `ButtonVariant.prominent`, `ButtonVariant.secondary`, `ButtonVariant.primary`, `ButtonVariant.ghost`, `ButtonSize.big`, `ButtonSize.sm` **Design System Exports:** - ESM and CJS formats -
